items.intro_words: Okay, let's see. Report out on closed session from April 22.
Moving on to oral communication. Ellie, I see one name here.
So if we have no oral communication other than the 13.1, we can go on and we'll address that when we come to that item onto the bond program.
Consent items. Item 9. Is there a motion to approve?
Okay, item 10.1. Recommendation for the approval of agreement for abatement construction with ATI at Hoover Community School.
Item 10.2, approval of new Jim and modernization project. Change order.
Item 10.3, adoption of resolution 24. Questions? Comments?
Approval of agreement for energy management systems. Yes. 10.4 is one of the supporting components of the energy management system.
And item 10.5, recommendation to approve the construction management consultant fee reconciliation proposals with RGM Creamer.
Okay, so we are moving on to item 11.1, a discussion on COVID 19.
Okay, so we are item 11.2, discussion of revisions to the board policy 5131.
Okay. Okay, so item 11.3, discussion of revisions to board policy 5145.9.
Okay. Okay. So item 11.4, Board Policy 6143. Correct.
Okay. Okay. So item 11.5, discussion of revisions to board policies 145.5.
Moving on to consent items. I do want to say, just for the audience, we've had a couple of speaker cards coming in, but they're for items that have already passed.
Moving on to consent, do we have a motion to approve? So moved.
So we have now item 13.1, the recommendation for the approval of permanently renaming 170 Selby Lane in Atherton.
With that said, it looks like we can move on to item 13 2, the joint use agreement with Touchstone Learning.
Item 13:3, the approval of personnel report. Thank you.
Item 13.4, approval of variable term waiver request. Yes.
And moving on to our final action, item 13.5, approval of resolution 25.
Moving on to item 14, reports from board members and superintendent.
Moving on to 15 information. 15.1 is contract update information and credit card summary.
Okay. 15, 2 information on San Mateo county investment fund.
Okay. 15.3 quarterly Williams report. Questions or comments?
Correspondence? None. Okay. I think we all got emails regarding the Arlante Selby Lane name.
Number 17 other business suggested items for future agenda.
Okay, where are we? Item 18, changes to the board agenda schedule.

Okay. I meant to say this earlier in the meeting, but to all of the teachers and parents that are in our audience right now, if you have a classroom or a student that would like to lead us in the Pledge of Allegiance, please take a video of it and email it to me.
